'''Nink''' was a [[dwarf opee sea killer]] that was held in the [[Otoh Gunga Zoological Research Facility|Zoological Research Facility]] of [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]] with another of its kind, [[Vink]], until a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] named [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] accidentally released them.
